LUCA Tradițional®

Soft mozzarella stick wrapped in ham and in classic pretzel dough, and sprinkled with poppy seeds—this classic always delivers. So tasty, you’ll come back for more, even if you’re trying to stick to your diet.

8 90 zł

FURTHER INFORMATION

Weight

120 g

Ingredients

Dough wick (WHEAT, refined vegetable oils and fats min. 80% (palm, sunflower), emulsifier: mono and diglycerides of fatty acids, flavoring), iodized salt), ham (firming agent: sodium lactate, sugars (dextrose ), vegetable protein from SOY, stabilizers: triphosphates, thickener: carrageenan, antioxidants: sodium ascorbate, extract rich in tocopherol, flavor enhancer: hydrolyzed vegetable protein, yeast extract, flavors, preservative: sodium nitrite, treatment of surface: sodium lactate, lactic acid), mozzarella sticks (MILK). May contain traces of LACTOSE, MUSTARD, CELERY.
